headline: Saber denies replacing Rideshare Stimulator’s writers with ChatGPT
summary: Saber CEO denies claims they replaced game writers with AI for 'Rideshare Stimulator'. Former lead writer, Stella Sacco, insists she was replaced by ChatGPT. The controversy highlights ongoing debates about AI's role in creative industries.

headline: Xbox Elite 3 prototype pad leaks with tiny built-in screen
summary: Photos of a prototype Xbox Elite Series 3 controller have leaked online. The leaked pad reportedly features a tiny built-in screen. A Redditor claims to have purchased the unreleased controller for $200.

headline: An FCC filing points to new Sonos headphones coming soon
summary: An FCC filing reveals details about new Sonos wireless headphones. This suggests a successor to the Sonos Ace headphones could launch this fall. The new model is identified by the number S52A.

headline: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
summary: Google's Gemini AI platform has reached 1 billion monthly users, its fastest-growing product. OpenAI's ChatGPT also recently surpassed the 1 billion user milestone. Both AI tools are rapidly expanding their global user base.

headline: Disney Confirms D23 Kingdom Hearts Panel Details, and Given Who's on It, We're Expecting Kingdom Hearts 4 News
summary: Disney has revealed details for a Kingdom Hearts panel at the D23 fan convention. The panel's lineup strongly suggests an announcement regarding Kingdom Hearts 4. Fans are anticipating major news this week.

headline: Huge Helldivers 2 Patch Adds New Illuminate Enemies, a New Biome 'Full of Fresh Horrors,' a Level Cap Increase and Much More
summary: Helldivers 2 released a major 7.0.0 patch with new content. The update introduces new Illuminate enemies and a terrifying new biome. Players can now enjoy a raised level cap and various other additions.

headline: The Elder Scrolls 6 Demo to Xbox Leadership Included a Giant Inflatable Rat, Placed Outside Bethesda Offices in Protest at Microsoft's Mass Layoffs
summary: Bethesda staff deployed a giant inflatable rat outside their offices. The protest occurred during an Xbox leadership visit to demo The Elder Scrolls 6. It signaled discontent over Microsoft's recent mass layoffs.

headline: Sony Announces Phantom Blade Zero State of Play and Everyone Knows How the Chat Is Going to Go
summary: Sony announced a dedicated State of Play for the action game Phantom Blade Zero. The announcement sparks predictions of online chat dominated by player anger. Frustration stems from Sony's decision to discontinue PlayStation disc support.

headline: Three ways to watch the solar eclipse safely without glasses
summary: Many shops are running out of solar eclipse glasses. Several safe methods exist to view the eclipse using common household items. Learn how to protect your eyes while enjoying the celestial event.

headline: Burnham says disposable BBQ ban under consideration
summary: The Prime Minister suggests banning single-use BBQs is being considered. The move aims to mitigate the current risks of wildfires. The public is urged not to use disposable grills during this period.

headline: Trump confirms he switched planes after Nato summit because of possible threat
summary: Donald Trump confirmed switching planes post-Nato summit over a potential threat. Journalists and White House staff on the original jet were unaware of the change. The details of the perceived threat were not fully disclosed.

headline: Early release scheme risks more serious crimes, probation chief warns
summary: England and Wales' chief inspector of probation warns of increased crime risks. The concern is linked to the current early release scheme for prisoners. Probation services are already under 'unprecedented pressure'.
